hook: Your whole world is less than one pixel.
title: Your Whole World Is Less Than One Pixel
description:
In 1990, Voyager 1 turned its camera back toward Earth from about 6 billion km away. In the photo, our whole planet is less than one pixel. It is called the Pale Blue Dot.

#Shorts #PaleBlueDot #Voyager1
comment_prompt: Does this make you feel small? Yes or no
